system.description:
See also: Hazards, Diseases

This disease is common throughout the galaxy and is typically only an inconvenience.

Cardooine Chills Statistics (CL 2)

Keywords: Atmosphere, Disease, Natural

Trigger: A creature is exposed to the Cardooine Chills.

Attack: +4 vs Fortitude Defense

Recurrence: Daily, until the Cardooine Chills is treated.

Suggested Skills: The following are suggested Skills for this Hazard:

  • Knowledge (Life Sciences) (DC 14): The character identifies the Cardooine Chills.
  • Treat Injury (DC 15; Requires Medical Kit): The character treats the Cardooine Chills.

Special: Once a creature has been exposed to the Cardooine Chills and the Disease has been treated, that creature can not contract the Disease again.
